newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTZ-CRA eyes Zaire for opportunities.
newsitem.headline: RTZ-CRA eyes Zaire for opportunities.

text.p: Global miner RTZ-CRA said on Wednesday it was following events in Zaire, now in rebel hands, and saw possible opportunities in the mineral-rich country.
RTZ-CRA chief executive Leon Davis said the group was not operating in Zaire, renamed The Congo by its new leadership, but opportunities might exist, especially in copper.
"I think the whole situation is very fluid," Davis told reporters after the group's Australian annual meeting in Melbourne.
Zaire holds known deposits but some of its existing mines are run down, Davis said.
"There may be opportunities, but we haven't been there. But we are watching the changing situation," he added.
Last week, rebels led by Laurent Kabila took control of the Zairean capital, Kinshasa, completing a rout of Mobutu Sese Seko's forces and ending the president's 32-year rule.
Zaire was once the world's largest copper exporter and also holds vast cobalt resources.
